items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And Ormond Hug played piano. ... Meyer Weinberg, Dave Weinstein either. He's the president of the union here. This is a misprint. These tunes we used to do in Nick's. ... Bill Bourgeois on bass, August Schilling on drums.

ctx.x: Bill Padron. And Dan LeBlanc played third alto. He had moved from bass to third alto. And Ormond Hug played piano. And I'm trying to remember the drummer. I can officialize him but I can't remember his name.
Is that the guy that's in some kind of carnival business today where he does decorations? Was this the guy that came in after Earl Crum?
